item.title: Rotherham rearranged game ticket information
item.description: Tickets for our Sky Bet League One fixture away at Rotherham United on Tuesday 03 March will go on general sale from 10am on Monday 09 February. Tickets purchased for the original fixture will remain valid for the rearranged date. The match will kick-off at 7.45pm. From the original allocation of 2,297 tickets, 580 are still available to purchase on a first-come first-served basis. The game – originally scheduled to take place on Sunday 04 January – was postponed due to a frozen pitch at AESSEAL

item.title: Kick-off time brought forward for Doncaster match
item.description: Our Sky Bet League One fixture away at Doncaster Rovers on Friday 03 April will now kick-off at the earlier time of 12.30pm. The Good Friday contest was originally scheduled to kick-off at 3pm but has now been brought forward after both clubs agreed to an earlier kick-off time. Ticket information for the fixture will be announced in due course.

item.title: Stockport away ticket information
item.description: Tickets for our Sky Bet League One fixture away at Stockport County on Saturday 07 March will go on sale to season ticket holders with 30 or more loyalty points from 10am on Tuesday 10 February. The club has received a full allocation of 1,160 tickets for the game. The match will kick-off at 3pm. Supporters can purchase tickets online at: stagstickets.co.uk. Alternatively, tickets can be purchased in person from One Call Stadium’s ticket office (Monday-Friday, 10am-5pm) and via telephone on 0162

item.description: Nigel Clough makes four changes to the side that drew with Wycombe last weekend. Harry Lewis makes his debut in place of Liam Roberts in goal. item.title: Report: Stags 0-0 Exeter
item.description: Mansfield Town stretched their impressive unbeaten run to nine matches this afternoon with a goalless draw at One Call Stadium against Exeter City. Both sides were resolute defensively in a game which lacked clear goalscoring opportunities, resulting in Stags collecting a hard-fought point. Manager Nigel Clough made four changes from the side that played out a stalemate with Wycombe Wanderers at One Call Stadium last Saturday.
